description.en: Finds DSH and GitHub projects, reads repository source, and packages author-adapted code as DSH plugin bundles. Supports native tool calls and explicit task messages with a user-authorized Legion service. Backend not included.
description.zh: 发现 DSH 与 GitHub 项目、读取仓库源码，并将作者已适配的代码包装为 DSH 插件包；支持原生工具调用和向用户获授权的 Legion 服务显式发送任务消息，不包含后端。
